apibank.label_scope: API-Bank synthetic success/failure label; balanced but synthetic label provenance.

bfcl.label_scope: BFCL v4 non-live executable/correct tool-call outcome; strongly positive-majority validation split.

tau2.label_scope: tau2 retail/airline task success after filtering; small filtered sample.

label_bce.label_use: Y is the direct BCE target for an existing X-only MLP baseline.
label_bce.objective: binary cross-entropy on benchmark success label

proposed_only.label_use: Y is used for compatibility evaluation metrics, not as a direct supervised head.

reconstruction_only.label_use: Y is used for compatibility evaluation metrics, not for training.

pickle_contract.S: payload['traj']['s'] float32 array (N, T), converted to o_hist/o_next sequence pairs.
pickle_contract.Y: binary success label (N,), used as safety-style compatibility metric target.
